declarations.name: Qf.lossy_projection_not_formal
declarations.statement_type: Qf.lossy_projection_not_formal (evidence : Qf.Evidence) : Qf.projectEvidence Qf.Projection.lossy evidence ≠ Qf.Evidence.formal

declarations.name: Qf.admit_informal_rejected
declarations.statement_type: Qf.admit_informal_rejected (current? : Option Qf.Declaration) (candidate : Qf.Declaration) (h : candidate.evidence ≠ Qf.Evidence.formal) : Qf.admitDeclaration current? candidate = Except.error Qf.SyncError.candidateNotFormal

declarations.name: Qf.admit_statement_conflict
declarations.statement_type: Qf.admit_statement_conflict (current candidate : Qf.Declaration) (hcurrent : current.evidence = Qf.Evidence.formal) (hkey : current.logicalKey = candidate.logicalKey) (hstatement : current.statementHash ≠ candidate.statementHash) : Qf.admitDeclaration (some current) { logicalKey := candidate.logicalKey, statementHash := candidate.statementHash, profileHash := candidate.profileHash, sourceCommit := candidate.sourceCommit, evidence := Qf.Evidence.formal } = Except.error Qf.SyncError.statementConflict

declarations.name: Qf.admit_same_statement_preserves_origin
declarations.statement_type: Qf.admit_same_statement_preserves_origin (current candidate : Qf.Declaration) (hcurrent : current.evidence = Qf.Evidence.formal) (hcandidate : candidate.evidence = Qf.Evidence.formal) (hkey : current.logicalKey = candidate.logicalKey) (hstatement : current.statementHash = candidate.statementHash) : Qf.admitDeclaration (some current) candidate = Except.ok current
